name: Ouji-sama Lv1
source:
The protagonist is Canaan, the second prince of Loukios kingdom, a small country in the Free Cities Alliance. He didn't have a special training, so he has the strength of any average boy.
One day, an adventurers guild is formed. They want to break the seal of a labyrinth that was closed a long time ago. Then, Canaan and his servant Celeste join the adventure...

[Translated from [url=http://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oujisama_Lv.1]Spanish Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
主人公Canaan是自由都市联盟中小国Loukios王国的第二王子。他没有接受过特殊训练，体力与普通少年无异。
一天，一个冒险者公会成立了。他们打算解除一座封闭已久的迷宫所受的封印。于是，Canaan与侍从Celeste也加入了这场冒险…

[翻译自[url=http://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oujisama_Lv.1]西班牙语Wikipedia[/url]]
